name: Eastern few-fruit sedge
desc: Eastern few-fruit sedge (Carex oligocarpa): a plant that turns sunlight into food. Recorded 3 times near the park in GBIF.
about: Carex oligocarpa, common name richwoods sedge, eastern few-fruited sedge, few-fruit sedge, and few-fruited sedge is a Carex species that is native to North America. It is a perennial.
